subject.title: Memory MVP: define SQLite schema and canonical record model

question: Should the Memory MVP move durable memory source of truth from Markdown-backed files plus a SQLite retrieval index into a typed SQLite canonical record model now, and what v1 boundary should be approved?
rationale: This would establish a persistent data model and product contract for memory writes, retrieval, review, and migration, which automation should not choose from source inspection alone.

options.title: Approve schema design first
options.body: Define a narrow memory-core/per-agent SQLite v1 record schema and migration contract before write, provenance, review, or CLI work proceeds.

options.title: Keep Markdown canonical
options.body: Leave MEMORY.md and memory/*.md as the durable source of truth and treat SQLite as retrieval index plus plugin state only.

options.title: Defer to memory convergence
options.body: Keep the issue open but block implementation until maintainers choose the recommended memory plugin path.

recommendation.title: Approve schema design first
recommendation.body: Define a narrow memory-core/per-agent SQLite v1 record schema and migration contract before write, provenance, review, or CLI work proceeds.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-core/schema history and related Memory MVP mentions make this the best available routing candidate, with product input likely still shared.
